title: Freeze constructor self-time as the next optimization gate without new instrumentation
question: After pruning retired profiler metrics in GPU-17, is another profiler or constructor bypass justified, or does existing exact-blob evidence already identify one concrete in-path cost strongly enough to gate the next production experiment?

evidence_reuse.identity_argument: The canonical daedalus/twin/relation_blocks.py blob is unchanged between the frozen GPU-13 constructor profile and the GPU-17 branch head, so the older profile measures the same production constructor implementation even though hosted-run wall times must not be compared as a controlled A/B benchmark.

frozen_same_blob_diagnostic.measurement_caveat: cProfile timings include observer overhead and the shares are attribution diagnostics only. They do not equal unprofiled wall-time shares and do not mint a speedup claim.

decision.next_active_cost: TypedRelationBlock.__post_init__ self/body work outside child helper frames is the strongest already-measured in-path constructor cost on the unchanged production blob.
decision.next_experiment_gate: Any production optimization candidate must target existing __post_init__ body/CSR structural work, preserve exact fail-closed error precedence and canonical digests, and be evaluated against the unchanged constructor on frozen cases before broader claims.

gardener_boundary.reason_for_no_code_change: Existing content-addressed evidence already answers the bounded research question. Adding another diagnostic or abstraction would increase bloat without changing the decision.

finding.summary: No new instrumentation is justified. On the unchanged canonical relation-block implementation, frozen cProfile evidence already attributes about 72.7% of profiled __post_init__ cumulative time in the largest bounded Boolean case to __post_init__ self/body work, versus about 27.2% to constructor-native _stored. The next bounded production experiment should therefore target existing CSR/body work rather than scalar bypasses, support decoding, caches, or another backend.
finding.negative_result: The evidence does not prove a wall-time speedup opportunity of the same magnitude, does not justify weakening validation, and does not authorize a trusted constructor or production promotion.
finding.next_implication: A later packet may test one minimal in-place __post_init__ structural optimization with exact error-precedence, digest, hash-seed, and same-case controls; until then no production constructor code is changed.

issue_scope.priority: continue bounded Fourfold/Tensor kernel research without parallel abstractions
